title: OpenPBR material swatches
exercises: MaterialX OpenPBR evaluation, one reference material per scene
MaterialX colorspace: ACEScg documents converted to linear Rec.709
USD composition: sublayers, references (incl. ../ asset paths), .mtlx references, material binding overrides
coat, fuzz, transmission, subsurface, thin film, metals through parallax on a single object

license.notice: OpenPBR and MaterialX example materials: Apache-2.0, Academy Software Foundation contributors. StandardShaderBall: CC-BY-4.0, usd-wg/assets contributors.

packs.loads_in: displayxr-demo-modelviewer >= the release containing #165 (MaterialX colorspace, ../ paths, .mtlx reference handling)

known_divergences: transmission_dispersion_* is not representable (no wavelength-dependent IOR): 11 refractive materials render without prismatic fringing.
The stock studio box (environment.usda) is left out: viewed from outside it hides the ball. Swatches are lit by the viewer's studio environment.
The ball's neutral base and core use a constant mid-grey OpenPBR shader: upstream's NodeGraph-routed neutral material is not loadable by tinyusdz.
